Emma (runtime): Need a quick decision on Q-slice bets for runtime perf. Customers pushing on embeddings throughput + tail. Can we pick two and spec launch criteria?
Sanjay Patel: AcmePayments is the driver here. They're seeing big tail at high batch sizes. Their requirement: sustain 1000 embeddings/sec on Dedicated 4xA100, avg <40ms, p99 <120ms. If we miss they'll consider other vendors.
Taylor W: Proposed options: (1) smarter KV prefixing + eviction tuning, (2) adaptive quantization canary, (3) fused-MHA kernel landing. We should pick two.
Liz C: Kernel landing needs infra capacity we don't have this quarter. I recommend KV work + quant canary this quarter, kernel next quarter unless we hire more infra.
Emma (runtime): Sanjay, can you confirm SLO targets so we can make concrete launch criteria?
Sanjay Patel: Confirming: sustain qps 1000, p50/p95/p99 reporting, p99 <120ms, 24h latency variance <=3%, quality drop <=1% vs baseline.
Taylor W: For launch criteria I suggest: p99 <=120ms, sustain >=1000 qps, 24h variance <=3%, embed-sim regression <=1% on golden set. Add automatic rollback conditions for regressions.
Liz C: Operational constraints: fail-open/fallback required. If quant path drops quality >1% or error_rate>1% auto-fallback to fp16. Canary triggers: p99>150ms, quality_drop>1.5%.
perf-bot: Perf snapshot: https://redwood.internal/perf/bench/1719456000 9 baseline kv hit 29%, simulated prefix-keying +13% hit, adaptive-8bit shows ~1.2% embed-sim delta on small eval.
Emma (runtime): OK locking top two: KV keying + eviction, and Adaptive quant canary. Kernel deferred. Any objections?
Taylor W: No objections. Rolling plan for adaptive quant:
- staging canary at 50% traffic for 48h
- continuous A/B eval every 2h on golden prompts
- automated rollback if embed_sim_delta > 0.01 or p99 increases >25%
Rollout snippet:
```
canary:
  traffic: 0.5
  duration: 48h
  metrics: [p99_latency, embed_sim_delta, error_rate]
  rollback_if: [embed_sim_delta > 0.01, p99_latency_increase > 0.25]
```
Liz C: I'll own the runbook and dashboard panels: p99, qps, kv_hit_rate, quant_mode, fallback_active. Also need a debug checklist for ops to triage quality regressions.
Sanjay Patel: One more Acme ask: can we add a cache-priming API so they can pre-warm embeddings before bursts? Low-effort shim would help.
Emma (runtime): Make cache-priming an SDK spike (1 week). If it lands quickly include in Phase 1.
Taylor W: I'll open tickets: canary infra, perf test harness, expand eval set, QC checks, SDK spike. ETA: planning by EOD, dev week+1.
Liz C: Also request adding a canary status indicator in Console showing recent eval deltas and fallback status.
Emma (runtime): Action items:\n- Taylor: tickets + perf tests\n- Liz: runbook + dashboards + Console indicator\n- Sanjay: finalize SLO doc for Acme\n- Emma: escalate kernel infra hiring to execs
If no objections I'll post this as the runtime roadmap slice for next quarter. :thumbsup:
Liz C: :thumbsup:
Sanjay Patel: LGTM
Taylor W: :rocket:
